verification_note: Maricopa County official results list Jay Tibshraeny 26823 under 'MAYOR - CITY OF CHANDLER'. Only one named candidate appeared, so this election has a winner and no runner-up. Chandler City Code, Chapter 4, Section 4-5 sets the denominator as the total of all votes tabulated for the office of Mayor. The winner below holds a majority on that basis, so the primary is the decisive stage.
